t: Formalize hub gardener as proper advisor following historian pattern with self-contained state
challenge: Hub-level advisors have no formal structure — state, scripts, and reports are scattered across unrelated directories, cluttering shared files like the registry.
hypothesis: If we formalize the gardener as a proper advisor at WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/ following the historian pattern, with self-contained state storage, then the gardener becomes discoverable, self-describing, and keeps the registry clean — because advisors should own their own state while leaning on shared infrastructure for awareness.
description: The gardener (fleet orchestrator) has scattered state: agent definition in .claude/agents/, script in scripts/, report target in WAI-Hub/runtime/, and last_tended shoehorned into hub-registry.json. Formalize it as a proper hub advisor at WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/ following the historian pattern. Advisor owns its own state — leans on registry for awareness but extends locally. No Ozi branding in gardener files. vectors.jsonl tracks fleet health patterns (registry completeness, session freshness, adoption rate, framework version) with evals to verify data completeness/correctness on each run.
perceive: 1. Check hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/ does not exist yet (first hub advisor). 2. Read hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md for current agent protocol — note Step 5 (registry timestamps), Step 4 (report path at runtime/ozi-nightly-reports/). 3. Read hub/scripts/gardener-wheel-tender.sh — note Python filter reads last_tended from hub-registry.json wheels, prompt includes jq command to update registry. 4. Confirm hub/WAI-Hub/runtime/ozi-nightly-reports/ is empty (no data to migrate). 5. Confirm no spoke in hub-registry.json has a last_tended field populated. 6. Read framework/WAI-Spoke/advisors/historian/ for target pattern: scan_state.json, passes.jsonl, vectors.jsonl, reviews/. 7. Run crontab -l to capture current cron entry path.
execute: 1. Create directory tree: mkdir -p hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/{reports,scripts}. 2. Create hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json with schema: {last_run_at: null, last_run_result: null, total_runs: 0, spokes_tended: {}, note: 'Fleet gardener state. Per-spoke last_tended lives here, not in hub-registry.json.'}. spokes_tended is keyed by spoke path, each entry: {last_tended, last_health, items_completed}. 3. Create empty hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/passes.jsonl (one JSONL entry per run: {id, timestamp, spokes_scanned, spokes_tended, items_attempted, items_completed, items_failed, teachings_adopted, signals_delivered, duration_seconds}). 4. Create empty hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/vectors.jsonl (fleet health patterns: registry completeness 35pts, session freshness 35pts, adoption rate 20pts, framework version 10pts — each spoke scored 0-100 per run, with evals block verifying data completeness). 5. Move hub/scripts/gardener-wheel-tender.sh to hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh. 6. Update wheel-tender.sh: change SCAN_STATE var to read WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json; Python filter reads scan_state['spokes_tended'].get(path, {}).get('last_tended') instead of registry; remove jq last_tended update from claude prompt; add prompt instruction to update scan_state.json + append passes.jsonl after each run; change report path to WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/reports/; rename log pattern from ozi-nightly to gardener-nightly; remove all Ozi branding from comments/logs. 7. Update hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md: rewrite Step 5 from 'Update Registry Timestamps' to 'Update Gardener State' writing to advisors/gardener/scan_state.json; change Step 4 report path to advisors/gardener/reports/; change Step 6 git add to WAI-Hub/advisors/; change commit message to 'Gardener nightly'; add passes.jsonl append instruction; add vectors.jsonl health-scoring with eval checks for data completeness and correctness. 8. Update crontab entry from old path to hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh. 9. Remove hub/scripts/gardener-wheel-tender.sh (already moved). 10. Remove empty hub/WAI-Hub/runtime/ozi-nightly-reports/ directory.
verify: 1. bash -n hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh — syntax passes. 2. python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json"))' — valid JSON. 3. Dry-run filter with SCAN_STATE pointing to new scan_state.json — all 17 spokes show as 'never tended'. 4. crontab -l shows new path hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh. 5. grep -r 'last_tended' hub/hub-registry.json returns no matches — registry is clean. 6. grep -r 'runtime/ozi-nightly' hub/.claude/agents/ returns no matches — no stale references. 7. test ! -f hub/scripts/gardener-wheel-tender.sh — old file gone. 8. test ! -d hub/WAI-Hub/runtime/ozi-nightly-reports — old dir gone. 9. grep -r 'ozi-nightly' hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/ returns no matches — no Ozi branding in gardener files. 10. Verify vectors.jsonl eval schema includes completeness and correctness checks.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Task to formalize the hub-level gardener as an advisor with self-contained state storage, following the spoke historian advisor pattern. Child of epic-hub-evolution-structure.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not about changing the gardener's functional behavior or protocol — only its organizational structure and state management. Not about renaming the agent definition file (ozi-gardener.md stays for claude CLI discovery).
